of.needed: which installation paths or existing CRD conversion settings trigger the Forbidden spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig error when applying 0.16.0

consequence.statement: Installing 0.16.0 can fail with the error "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook".
consequence.remediation: Use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on your installation path.

assertion.statement: Installing or upgrading to 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook"; upstream says to use 0.16.1 instead, where this is fixed.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The prose is a troubleshooting note that quotes an error message. It does not name the setting or artifact that changed. The rendered diffs show spec.conversion removed from the chart's CRDs, but no source links that removal to the error, and CustomResourceDefinition spec.conversion does not fit a product-owned subject family.; change: The text gives a symptom and a workaround (use 0.16.1), not the change itself. The rendered removal of the CRDs' webhook conversion block is not stated as the cause.
